body:
The original targeter appends repository-relative pytest paths after a bootstrap `cd`, producing `Tests/Tests/...` for the recorded Biopython command. #58 reproduced file-not-found exit 4 with the pinned helper and a faithful synthetic layout. #57 never ran PR validation, so this remains a source/fixture finding. Subissue of #33; dependency for #58.

A separate opt-in generic adapter roots newly appended Python targets at `/workspace`, quotes them for the shell and preserves recognized existing targets/node IDs. It does not change cwd, tests, imports/install, parser, reward, deadlines or resources. [Candidate and evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4baab097/experiments/59-pytest-targeting/results.md): eight paired real pytest layouts (16 processes), unsafe paths/changed callback rejected, non-pytest behavior unchanged. Two filename-with-space cases run but the original parser returns no identities; scientific acceptance remains unsupported there, with no parser/JUnit rescue.

Latest official 0.9.4 adds `py.test` aliases but still emits the same wrong path for the recorded command; this is not whole-function/release parity. The adapter is a declared behavior change, not the official baseline. No native integration, biology run, model call or new admission; no repository/PR-specific repair. Owned scratch removed, source and complete notices retained.

Next: bind the policy and #58's official boolean option into a separately tested/frozen candidate after #57 billing/archival/cleanup resolves. Same existing 32 CPUh/$90 operating ceiling, strictly below $100 extra; no new allowance/capacity. Native controls and scientific acceptance remain unproven. Keep child/epic open for review; logs in comments, no merge/release.
